payload.answer:
Under Solicitation 01 (`SOL-2026-CLOUD-01`), the combined dollar SLA service credit owed under Exhibit 05 (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1) is **$13,750.00** (or **$12,500.00** if CLIN-0002-AA is categorized as a P2 High Non-Core Service).

---

### 1. Applicable SLA Formula and Tiers (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1)
Per Clause SLA-4.2 (Monthly Infrastructure Availability & Service Credit Formula) in `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf` (Page 1), service credits are calculated using the formula `Credit_USD = Monthly_CLIN_Invoice * Credit_Percentage` based on the following availability tiers:
* **P1 Critical (`99.99% Target (<99.99% to 99.50%)`):** `10% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.
* **P1 Severe Breach (`< 99.50% Monthly Availability`):** `25% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.
* **P2 High (`< 99.90% Non-Core Services`):** `5% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Credit Calculation for Month 4

#### **A. Shared VPC & Landing Zone Core (CLIN-0001-AA)**
* **Monthly CLIN Fee:** According to Schedule B (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-0001-AA has a base rate of **$45,000/mo**.
* **Applicable SLA Tier:** At **99.40%** monthly availability (`< 99.50%`), CLIN-0001-AA triggers a **P1 Severe Breach**, which carries a **25%** service credit (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
* **SLA Credit Owed:** `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf` (Page 1) explicitly provides this exact calculation as an example: `$45,000 * 0.25 = $11,250.00`.

#### **B. GKE Enterprise Managed Cluster (CLIN-0002-AA, 20 Active Nodes)**
* **Monthly CLIN Fee:** According to Schedule B (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-0002-AA is billed per `Node-Mo` at a base rate of **$1,250/mo** (with 240 total Node-Months in Year 1, or 20 nodes per month). For 20 active nodes in Month 4, the monthly CLIN invoice is `20 nodes * $1,250/mo = $25,000.00` (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1).
* **Applicable SLA Tier & Credit (Primary — P1 Critical):** In Statement of Work Section 2.1 (`02_Statement_of_Work_SOW.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-0002-AA supports "Core ERP & 45 Microservices on GKE". At **99.70%** monthly availability, it falls within the **P1 Critical** range (`<99.99% to 99.50%`), which carries a **10%** service credit (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
  * **SLA Credit Owed (P1 Critical):** `$25,000.00 * 0.10 = $2,500.00` (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1; `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
* **Alternative Tier (If Treated as P2 High Non-Core Services):** If CLIN-0002-AA were evaluated under the **P2 High** tier (`< 99.90% Non-Core Services`), a **5%** service credit would apply, equaling `$25,000.00 * 0.05 = $1,250.00` (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1; `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).

---

### 3. Combined Dollar SLA Service Credit Summary

| CLIN | Service Description | Month 4 Invoice | Availability | SLA Tier & Credit % | Dollar Credit Owed |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **CLIN-0001-AA** | Shared VPC & Landing Zone Core | $45,000.00 | 99.40% | P1 Severe Breach (25%) | **$11,250.00** |
| **CLIN-0002-AA** | GKE Enterprise Managed Cluster (20 nodes) | $25,000.00 | 99.70% | P1 Critical (10%) *(or P2 High 5%)* | **$2,500.00** *(or $1,250.00)* |
| **Combined Total** | | **$70,000.00** | | | **$13,750.00** *(or $12,500.00)* |

Based on `04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf` (Page 1) and `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf` (Page 1), the combined SLA service credit owed is **$13,750.00** (`$11,250.00 + $2,500.00`), or **$12,500.00** (`$11,250.00 + $1,250.00`) if CLIN-0002-AA is classified as a non-core service.

Under Solicitation 01 (`SOL-2026-CLOUD-01`), the combined dollar SLA service credit owed under Exhibit 05 (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1) is **$13,750.00** (or **$12,500.00** if CLIN-0002-AA is categorized as a P2 High Non-Core Service).

---

### 1. Applicable SLA Formula and Tiers (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1)
Per Clause SLA-4.2 (Monthly Infrastructure Availability & Service Credit Formula) in `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf` (Page 1), service credits are calculated using the formula `Credit_USD = Monthly_CLIN_Invoice * Credit_Percentage` based on the following availability tiers:
* **P1 Critical (`99.99% Target (<99.99% to 99.50%)`):** `10% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.
* **P1 Severe Breach (`< 99.50% Monthly Availability`):** `25% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.
* **P2 High (`< 99.90% Non-Core Services`):** `5% of Monthly CLIN Fee`.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Credit Calculation for Month 4

#### **A. Shared VPC & Landing Zone Core (CLIN-0001-AA)**
* **Monthly CLIN Fee:** According to Schedule B (`04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf`, Page 1), CLIN-0001-AA has a base rate of **$45,000/mo**.
* **Applicable SLA Tier:** At **99.40%** monthly availability (`< 99.50%`), CLIN-0001-AA triggers a **P1 Severe Breach**, which carries a **25%** service credit (`05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf`, Page 1).
* **SLA Credit Owed:** `05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf` (Page 1) explicitly provides this exact calculation as an example: `$45,000 * 0.25 = $11,250.00`.
